d: Chris designs a custom circular dining table for a client from a pair of expensive Claro walnut slabs, learning key lessons along the way  disaster strikes when the CNC accidentally cuts through the tabletop while milling a C-channel  after refunding the client, Chris rethinks the table design  he adds additional C-channels and oak inlays that match the base and conceal the repair.

Chris builds a 46-inch round "spider" table from leftover Claro walnut slabs  after the epoxy cures, he flattens the top on a CNC and trims it with a router  after crafting the eight walnut "spider" legs, he machines a central hub joint  but, before assembly, he rethinks the design, flips the base, and attaches the top using recessed, custom-cut aluminum discs.
Brad explores recessed lighting options, sharing tips on choosing the right lumens, spacing, style, form factor, calculating light output, and modernizing lighting beyond standard can lights.
Installing recessed lighting is a great way to brighten any room, and Brad walks us through 12 simple, cost-saving steps to get the job done right.

st: Channel: A Folding Patio Table Fit for a Breakfast of Champions
d: Jason makes an outdoor patio table from stock cedar using butt joints and stainless-steel screws for fasteners  because he lives where it often rains, the finished table folds easily for storage.

st: Channel: A Rolling Librarian Ladder (Library Not Included)
d: Jason builds a rolling librarian ladder out of solid white oak  for the tracking system, he connects sections of half-inch diameter steel piping using steel tees and elbows.

st: Channel: Making a Classic Dutch Tool Chest
d: Anne builds a Dutch tool chest using a series of basic joineries  the chest makes transporting her collection of custom tools easy and offers safe and secure storage.

st: Channel: Putting Blacksmithing Skills to Work
d: Anne puts her welding and blacksmithing skills to the test, forging nail headers and a set of sturdy handles for her Dutch tool chest.
Jamison builds a new drip-free deck off the second-floor main bedroom of the lake house  he builds a plywood nightstand featuring a hidden drawer.

st: Channel: Lake House: Window Jambs & Trim
d: Jamison builds custom recessed window frames using pocket-hole joinery and shares tips for installing window trim, as well as how to avoid common mistakes and hide imperfections.

st: Channel: Tiny House Build Pt. 9: Storage Solutions
d: With the essentials like her bed and kitchen in place, Laura focuses on storage solutions  she makes a mixed material lift-top bench with one end covered in leather and the other in linoleum.

st: Channel: Tiny House Build Pt. 10: The Coziest Place, Ever
d: Laura recaps how her tiny house came to be and is reminded how much she loves designing for space and living simply.

st: Channel: How to Build a Modern Console Table
d: Chris builds a media console out of walnut and white oak.
